description: This file contains macro definitions and function implementations for managing slabs of commit data structures, including initialization, clearing, deep clearing, and access functions.

methods.name: init_ ##slabname## _with_stride
methods.description: Initializes a slab with a specified stride, setting size parameters based on COMMIT_SLAB_SIZE.

methods.name: init_ ##slabname
methods.description: Initializes a slab with default stride of 1.

methods.name: clear_ ##slabname
methods.description: Clears a slab by freeing its allocated memory and resetting count.

methods.name: deep_clear_ ##slabname
methods.description: Deep clears a slab by applying a custom free function to each element.

methods.name: slabname##_at_peek
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to an element in the slab based on commit index, optionally adding if missing.

methods.name: slabname##_at
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to an element in the slab, adding if missing.

methods.name: slabname##_peek
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to an element in the slab without adding if missing.
